title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's World Cup fallout, transfer records and Israeli clubs in Europe.

questions.question: Argentina entered the 2026 World Cup final as defending champions but were beaten by which country at MetLife Stadium on July 19?
questions.explanation: Spain won 1-0 after extra time, claiming their second World Cup title and first since 2010.

questions.question: Chelsea broke the British transfer record this summer by signing Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa for £117 million. Which player's fee did that surpass as Chelsea's previous most expensive signing?
questions.explanation: The £117m Rogers fee topped the £115m Chelsea paid for Moises Caicedo in 2023.

questions.question: Which Israeli basketball club is competing with Partizan Belgrade to sign free-agent forward Wendell Moore Jr.?
questions.explanation: Hapoel Jerusalem's pursuit of Moore, a 2022 first-round NBA draft pick, is now being challenged by Partizan Belgrade.

questions.question: Israel international Mohammed Abu Fani made his first European fixture since joining from Ferencváros while starting in central midfield for which club against Larne?
questions.explanation: Abu Fani started for Red Star Belgrade in their Champions League second qualifying round first leg at Larne, his first European match since his June 2026 move.

questions.question: Kings Kangwa scored to level the match for Hapoel Beer Sheva, but the Israeli side still lost their Champions League qualifier to which Icelandic club?
questions.explanation: Nikolaj Hansen scored twice for Víkingur Reykjavík, either side of Kangwa's equalizer, as Beer Sheva fell 2-1 in the first leg.
